authority: T0 exact restricted finite-image Weyl/state-pullback construction and route-splitting no-go certificate; not a TECT claim, tier change, full quantum boundary theorem, physical-state theorem, CP1 completion, or Pre-A closure
statement: On the inserted ordered collective CL8 background with L=pi/2, c/chi=1 and -2r/chi=9, the three real modes 1, cos(4x), sin(4x) form an exact six-dimensional linearized Goursat symplectic image with frequencies 3,5,5. For every even M>=4, collective point sampling of this restricted band is injective and exactly preserves the CL8 CCR form, so its composition with the characteristic map induces a Weyl monomorphism into the fixed-regulator bulk algebra. Every previously constructed fixed-regulator CL8 ground or Gibbs normal state therefore pulls back to an exact state on this restricted boundary algebra. Unrestricted point sampling cannot induce an exact Weyl homomorphism, the nonlinear Goursat map cannot be quantized by direct Weyl-generator relabelling, and the current centered lattice dispersion cannot exactly intertwine even the first nonzero ordered tangent mode. Thus a conditional finite-image boundary-state ingredient is closed while the full interacting boundary algebra, exact dynamics, regulator compatibility, physical selection, C0 and N1-N5 remain open.
verdict: CLOSE THE ORDERED-TANGENT FINITE-IMAGE WEYL MONOMORPHISM AND BULK-STATE PULLBACK; FORMALLY REJECT UNRESTRICTED POINT-SAMPLING WEYL, DIRECT NONLINEAR GENERATOR RELABELLING, AND CURRENT EXACT DYNAMICS INTERTWINING; KEEP THE PARENT QUANTUM-BOUNDARY GATE OPEN

ordered_tangent_finite_image.scope: this is the tangent theory around one inserted ordered background and a finite spectral image, not the nonlinear Goursat map, the full trace algebra, or a continuum Fock theorem

restricted_sampling_theorem.bulk_phase_space: V_a consists of 8M q and 8M Pi coordinates with sigma_a=(a/8)sum_(j,e)(q_1*Pi_2-q_2*Pi_1)

restricted_sampling_theorem.result: R_a is injective on P_6 and sigma_a(R_a v,R_a w)=sigma_Sigma(v,w); hence K_a is a linear symplectic embedding and alpha_a is a Weyl monomorphism
restricted_sampling_theorem.not_dynamics: the theorem is kinematic at one slice; the current centered lattice and continuum dispersions differ at every finite a on the first nonzero mode

nonlinear_generator_relabel_no_go.classification: if a unital star-homomorphism of generator-relabel form alpha(W(z))=exp(i*theta(z))*W(F(z)) preserves the Weyl product and its generator-label map F is continuous in the real phase-space topology, then F is additive and hence real-linear; the commutator relation then makes F symplectic, up to the compatible phase character
nonlinear_generator_relabel_no_go.CL8_witness: at the actual ordered collective background v0=sqrt(-r/g), use collective traces A=B=v0+epsilon. The second data variation z has zero axis traces and satisfies 4chi*z_uv+(-2r)z=-6g*v0*eta^2. Since eta=1 on the axes, z_v(u,0)=-3g*v0*u/(2chi); along the final slice u+nu=2tau its endpoint derivative is -3g*v0*tau/chi, nonzero for every tau>0. Hence the fixed ordered characteristic-to-final-phase map is not affine. The r=lambda=0 cubic third-variation fixture is retained as an independent control.
nonlinear_generator_relabel_no_go.conclusion: the fixed ordered nonlinear CL8 characteristic-to-final-phase map, and therefore the full admitted nonlinear family, cannot be quantized by direct Weyl-generator relabelling
nonlinear_generator_relabel_no_go.survivors: a nonlinear unitary acting outside generator closure, an enlarged observable algebra, Fourier-integral or semiclassical Egorov methods, perturbative algebraic QFT, path integrals, or deformation quantization
